seo.title: Matemwe Boutique Retreat | Zanzibar Heavenly
seo.description: Intimate boutique hotel on Matemwe’s quiet coast with garden pool, yoga classes, and easy access to Mnemba Atoll. From $140/night with breakfast.

content:
Matemwe Boutique Retreat is a small, soulful hotel tucked into tropical gardens on one of Zanzibar’s most peaceful stretches of coast. With just twelve rooms, the atmosphere is intimate and unhurried—the kind of place where the staff know your name by the second morning and your coffee arrives exactly how you like it.

Rooms are housed in whitewashed coral-stone cottages with makuti-thatched roofs, each opening onto a private veranda framed by frangipani and bougainvillea. The design is a refined take on Swahili coastal style: hand-carved bed frames, woven sisal rugs, and driftwood accents, all kept cool by air conditioning and ceiling fans. Mornings begin with yoga on the wooden deck overlooking the garden, followed by a leisurely breakfast of tropical fruit, freshly baked bread, and Zanzibari coffee. The pool is shaded by palms, and the beach—a wide sweep of white sand that stretches for miles—is a two-minute barefoot walk away. Boats to Mnemba Atoll leave from the shore right in front of the retreat, making this the perfect base for serious snorkellers and divers.
